title: Seven Small Habits Are Quietly Wearing Down Your Camera
excerpt: A shattered filter rarely comes from a fall off a cliff. Photographer Michael Scott traces most gear damage back to seven small, everyday habits — and every fix costs seconds, not money.

title: A Street Camera Crossed Kyrgyzstan on a Bicycle
excerpt: A 25-day bikepacking crossing of Kyrgyzstan, over 1,000 kilometres at altitude, shot on a street camera and three lenses weighing under three pounds. The lesson is not about the camera. It is about choosing for the job.

title: Turn a Toy Car Into a Luxury Car With Forced Perspective
excerpt: The Hollywood trick behind The Lord of the Rings works in your driveway: a toy car, a homemade base, and f/16 can make a 25cm remote-control car look like the real thing. The failed first attempt is the lesson.
